# Dorian Award for Outstanding LGBTQ Broadway Production

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding LGBTQ Broadway Production is one of the main categories of Dorian Theatre Awards, given annually to the best production of a play or musical, either new or a revival, featuring the LGBTQ community on Broadway. The award has been voted on by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway theatre.
